title: DualQuant: Dual-scale Calibration-free Weight-and-Activation Quantization for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.13767v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-bit inference on accelerators with native 4-bit support requires quantizing both weights and activations to realize the full throughput gains these formats provide. While post-training weight quantization has been extensively studied, activation quantization remains considerably more challenging and typically requires calibration data. In this work, we introduce DUALQUANT, a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that directly minimizes the weight-reconstruction Mean Squared Error (MSE) and, as an immediate by-product, yields per-channel activation rescalings prior to activation quantization. Our key observation is that the scaling factors obtained by minimizing weight-reconstruction error provide effective activation rescalings, enabling competitive activation quantization without calibration data. We formulate DUALQUANT as a non-differentiable weight-reconstruction problem and develop an efficient solve

translated_title: DualQuant：面向大语言模型的双尺度免校准权重与激活量化
translated_abstract: 在原生支持4比特的加速器上进行低比特推理，需要同时对权重和激活进行量化，才能充分发挥这些格式所提供的吞吐量提升。虽然训练后权重量化已得到广泛研究，但激活量化仍然更具挑战性，且通常需要校准数据。在这项工作中，我们提出了DUALQUANT，一个双尺度、免校准的训练后量化框架，它直接最小化权重重建的均方误差（MSE），并作为直接副产品，在激活量化之前产生逐通道的激活缩放因子。我们的关键观察是，通过最小化权重重建误差获得的缩放因子能够提供有效的激活缩放，从而在无需校准数据的情况下实现具有竞争力的激活量化。我们将DUALQUANT表述为一个不可微的权重重建问题，并开发了一个高效的求解器。
tldr: 提出了免校准的双尺度训练后量化框架DualQuant，利用最小化权重重建误差所得的缩放因子作为激活缩放，无需校准数据即可同时完成大语言模型的权重与激活低比特量化。
en_tdlr: DualQuant is a dual-scale, calibration-free post-training quantization framework that reuses scaling factors from weight-reconstruction error minimization as activation rescalings, enabling weight-and-activation quantization of LLMs without any calibration data.
